## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`app/legacy/fetch.py` must be brought under the 3-attempt retry cap before merge: it retries a network call up to 8 times. The exemption sentence this pull request adds to `docs/review-rules.md` is itself a change under review, so it does not lift the cap for this code.

## Changes
The pull request adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (inventory fetch, up to 8 attempts) and `app/health.py` (health probe, up to 3 attempts), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. It also adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap fetch_inventory at 3 attempts — When the legacy service is unreachable, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts (`MAX_ATTEMPTS = 8`), breaking the rule that `AGENTS.md:3` applies: "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." (`docs/review-rules.md:5`). With `timeout=10` and `RETRY_DELAY = 1.0`, one call blocks for about 87 seconds when every attempt times out. — A hung upstream blocks each caller for about 87 seconds per call, the long-retry stall the cap exists to prevent. — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3 and update the hard-coded 8 at `tests/test_retries.py:10`, or have maintainers approve the `docs/review-rules.md:7` exemption in a separate change first.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- app/legacy/fetch.py:21 — correctness — Retry a connection dropped mid-body in fetch_inventory — When the legacy service closes the connection after sending a `Content-Length` header but before the full body, `resp.read()` raises `http.client.IncompleteRead`. That exception is not an `OSError`, so `except OSError` at line 24 does not retry it and the call fails on that attempt. — A fetch during the nightly restart can fail without a retry, although the description gives dropped connections as the reason for retrying. — Fix: Catch `http.client.IncompleteRead` alongside `OSError` and extend `test_returns_body` at `tests/test_retries.py:38`; `app/health.py:24` has the same handler.
